title: Welcome to the Workshop Site
description: Start with the home page to understand the application's purpose, navigation structure, and how users access different parts of the platform.

title: Process Payments on the Backend
description: Learn how the checkout API endpoint receives form data, creates Stripe sessions, and integrates with the Stripe client configuration to handle payment initialization.

title: Manage Data and Handle Webhooks
description: Complete the flow by understanding how Stripe webhooks confirm payments, how the Supabase client stores subscription data, and what the database schema looks like for persisting customer and subscription information.
